anomalies.observed: The same global net label NET0036 appears on the reset switch S2, on SKW92A pin 45, and on EPD connector J8 pin 14.
anomalies.expected: S2 pin 2 should be connected only to the dedicated HW_RESET net, while J8 pin 14 should be the EPD SDA/SPI_MOSI signal. The specification maps these as separate nets: HW_RESET to SKW92A pin 45 and SDA/SPI_MOSI to the module SPI/GPIO line.

anomalies.impact: The hardware-reset switch/net is shorted to the e-paper display's SDA/MOSI line. Pressing reset or driving the module reset pin will disturb the EPD data line, corrupting display commands, and the EPD panel will load the reset line.

parsed.summary: The schematic merges the HW_RESET switch net with the EPD SDA/SPI_MOSI line via NET0036, which is an unintended bridged-net deviation from the specified separate reset and display-data connections.
